cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

mechanism: A offers familiar care as the sole competent provider while corrections expose unresolved resentment.
confusable: Simple passive aggression lacks the sustained patient correction of how care should be performed.
comparison: A late birthday cake requires serving; a cold partner needs practical warming and hears remembered neglect.
seedUse: Retain the birthday and cold-feet seeds but make the actual care technique carry the resentment.
